reviewer_statement: Provisional six-domain author review. Genuine native Gaussian spline nlme fit-derived scientific arrays, source artist geometry and frozen Python 1.2 Matplotlib line comparisons are implemented and tests committed, not yet observed passing. No claim of Python statsmodels optimizer, plotting Axes runtime, or independent scientific certification.
native_language_semantic_policy: Accepted source parity scope is fitted native R Gaussian likelihood scientific plot arrays, labels, physical lag origins/uncertainty values and source horizontal reference line conventions. R base graphics returns typed scientific data; it cannot instantiate or return Python Matplotlib Axes, copy error classes, or guarantee pixel-identical backend rendering.

case_evidence.description: Pinned Python 1.2 src/eyetrajectoriespy/functional_mixed_effects_covariance_sensitivity.py::plot_covariance_sensitivity_coefficients, matched by native strict scientific plot mode rather than replacing actual statistical calculations.

Strict science requires genuine prior native Gaussian joint spline likelihood fits, source-scientific W3 covariance-sensitivity result, explicitly declared successful reference and real fitted coefficient differences on source time grid. Does not fit, rank or select covariance structures; a plain R fabricated list or timewise moments fit is rejected. Frozen Python Matplotlib ax injection is not a native R capability.

Uses actual native fitted fixed coefficient functions and reference subtraction from source coefficient_frame, one source line per successful declared specification in source order, zero horizontal baseline, exact coefficient names and original observed time grid. New real 24-curve/8-participant Gaussian native nlme fit and source sensitivity tests, direct frozen Python 1.2 public Matplotlib line data comparisons. Exact-head runs not observed green.

Missing coefficient fails closed; failed models produce no line, unsupported R-only specs/moments results fail strict class provenance, and missing actual successful Gaussian fits fail. Python KeyError/TypeError classes and axis injection are not preserved.

Return native one-panel source-scientific artist data with source title Covariance sensitivity: {coefficient}, original Time (unit), Coefficient difference from reference, ordered model line labels, true numerical arrays and horizontal y=0. Matplotlib Axes identity and pixel-perfect colors not produced; pre-existing native R default returns unchanged source coefficient dataframe.

Descriptive fixed functional regression coefficient differences for explicitly predeclared covariance model sensitivities, based on genuine R nlme Gaussian mixed-likelihood fits and single source reference, without automatic inferential ranking.

independent_review_status: New tests/CI committed; no successful exact-head execution or independent source-contract certification witnessed.
language_specific_limits: Matplotlib Axes, Figure backend, injected Python ax and pixel-identical graphics cannot be produced by a native R base graphics result.
The real R nlme Gaussian spline likelihood optimizer differs from Python statsmodels MixedLM and may yield different fitted boundary estimands.
Accepted source plot data reflect the exact already-fitted native scientific model, not independently proved end-to-end optimizer parity.
The band-width ratio plot remains OPEN because current joint likelihood sensitivity intentionally refuses unqualified simultaneous bands; it is NOT counted as closed.
Independent Python exception type/state parity and external reviewer sign-off are outstanding.
